headline: Microsoft details pay-as-you-go Xbox Cloud Gaming pricing
summary: Microsoft is previewing a pay-as-you-go Xbox Cloud Gaming option for players without Game Pass, with bundles starting at $3.99 for 10 hours, on top of what players already paid for the games.

claims.statement: Microsoft is adding a pay-as-you-go Xbox Cloud Gaming option that doesn't require a Game Pass subscription.

sources.quote: Microsoft announced last month that it will let anyone access Xbox Cloud Gaming in November, without the need to subscribe to Xbox Game Pass.
Xbox is previewing paid cloud gaming for players without Game Pass

claims.statement: Bundles of cloud hours start at $3.99 for 10 hours, around 24 to 40 cents per hour.

sources.quote: Xbox Cloud Gaming’s pay-as-you-go option starts at $3.99 for 10 hours
Xbox wants you to pay 24 to 40 cents per hour to stream games you already bought

claims.statement: The hourly charges come on top of the purchase price of the games themselves.

sources.quote: Time-based a la carte charges come on top of the purchase price for the games themselves.

claims.statement: Engadget reports the preview also comes with new rate limits.
